subject: URGENT: A/B Test Budget Overage Alert - JOB-704 Social Sharing Experiment
body:

If valid, we'll need:

2. Verification of actual runtime from system logs
3. Stakeholder approval for the overage
4. Updated expense entry in the finance system

Please respond by EOD today so we can close Q1 books on time.

Best regards,
Wang Jing
Finance Liaison | Kuaigou Technology
